title: Farinuff Flight — Voxel Bosses
source_type: Original voxel geometry and rigid animation authored locally in Blender for this project
exact_user_prompt: Could you make new voxel models for the bosses? With animations too?
negative_prompt_note: No separate negative prompt was supplied; local Blender authoring used no paid generation provider.

style_provenance.prior_request_context: Voxel enemies and debris, game-matched style, professional packaging, and visible runtime textures/shaders.
style_provenance.shared_original_atlas: Voxel Frontier grayscale panel atlas; copied into this package so its GLBs/source remain portable
style_provenance.visual_direction: Stepped hard-surface silhouettes, dark structural cores, restrained emission, readable boss palettes and distinct class geometry

license_note: No repository-wide license grant was present. This package does not grant a new public redistribution license; the project owner controls release terms.

coordinate_system.units: 1 source unit = 1 glTF unit; runtime boss scenes apply their existing presentation scale
coordinate_system.origin: Central hull datum; geometric bounds may be asymmetric

validation_scope.static: Actual GLB geometry, UVs, materials, embedded atlas, named rigid rig, clips, sockets and package digests
validation_scope.runtime: Rendered shader/texture visibility and gameplay animation evidence are recorded separately; static file checks do not establish final appearance or performance

third_party_integration_references.reference: Deep-Fold PixelPlanets NoAtmosphere and GasLayers shaders
